description.subtitle: Nike 2nd Equipment T-shirt from Chelsea 2025 2026 player version - white

Designed for the most demanding, it combines athletic fit and advanced technology to master every move. Inspired by the club’s official equipment, it offers you a genuine and high performance design. Ideal for players and collectors looking for the best.

Official design version Match: Same as the Chelsea professionals use.
Aerodynamic slim adjustment: Improves mobility and reduces friction.
Ultralight technical fabric: Fresh sensation even in the most intense matches.
Professional club inspiration: Reflect your passion with authentic style.
